name: ado-gateway
title: ADO Gateway
summary: Read Azure DevOps work items and PR discussions, normalize them, and emit a deterministic handoff contract for downstream skills.

use_when: Fetching Azure DevOps backlog items or work items
Fetching Azure DevOps pull request comments from a URL or explicit identifiers
Parsing Azure DevOps pull request URLs into concrete identifiers
Normalizing Azure DevOps data for another skill
avoid_when: The task requires posting or editing Azure DevOps data
The task is a GitHub pull request review
The task is generating or validating an OpenSpec file
